image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vintage agricultural plow resting on grassy ground. The image focuses heavily on a large, black rubber tire with a metal rim on the left side. To the right, a rusty, wedge-shaped metal share (blade) is visible, partially embedded in the earth. Above the wheel, a rusted metal frame and hitch mechanism are visible against a background of dense green foliage.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the tire rubber appears slightly smudged or 'painted' rather than having distinct, sharp tread grooves. The transition between the rim and the tire is soft.
The metal bars in the upper center appear to merge into each other without clear bolted joints or logical mechanical connections. Some edges bleed into the background foliage.
The concentric circles of the wheel hub appear slightly elliptical in a way that doesn't perfectly match the perspective of the tire outer edge, suggesting minor geometric warping.

To verify that the share is physically grounded and the wheel is supporting the frame correctly in 3D space, checking for floating elements.
